Analyst rates KKR Real Estate Finance Trust

Summary We continue to hold KKR Real Estate Finance Trust's Series A preferred shares, supported by KKR's brand and 18% ownership. KREF.PR.A has delivered a slightly positive total return since mid-year, outperforming preferred peers despite higher rates and portfolio stress. KREF's portfolio is stabilizing, not improving: roughly 15% is rated Risk-5, while higher rates could extend resolutions and generate additional credit losses. KREF.PR.A yields approximately 9%, with pricing reflecting an expected resolution within two years; a sale or orderly unwind could repay preferred holders at par.

KREF의 포트폴리오는 개선되는 것이 아니라 안정화되고 있습니다. 약 15%가 Risk-5 등급으로 평가되었으며, 금리 인상은 문제 해결 기간을 연장하고 추가 신용 손실을 발생시킬 수 있습니다.
